privacy.title: Zaheen Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Zaheen is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your information when you use our educational platform.
privacy.collectText: We may collect your mobile number, account information, subscription details, device/browser information, IP address, usage data, and communications with customer support.
privacy.useText: We use your information to provide and improve our services, manage subscriptions, verify eligibility, process billing through Zong, provide customer support, communicate service updates, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.zongText: Premium services are available only to eligible Zong subscribers. Subscription and billing information may be shared with Zong solely to activate, manage, renew, or cancel your subscription.
privacy.cookiesText: We may use cookies and similar technologies to improve website functionality, remember preferences, and analyze usage. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers, Zong for subscription management, or where required by law.
privacy.securityText: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, but no online system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.retentionText: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access to or correction of your personal information and may unsubscribe from promotional communications. Subscription-related records may be retained as required by law.
privacy.childrenText: Zaheen is available to users of all ages. Where required by law, parents or guardians should supervise minors using the Platform.
privacy.thirdPartyText: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.
privacy.updatesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Zaheen. By accessing or using the Zaheen educational platform, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the Platform.
terms.aboutText: Zaheen is an online educational platform providing learning resources, quizzes, study materials and other educational content. Premium content requires an active subscription.
terms.eligibilityText: Zaheen is available to users of all ages. Where required by applicable law, minors should use the Platform under the supervision or consent of a parent or legal guardian.
terms.zongText: Premium subscription services are exclusively available to Zong Pakistan subscribers with an active Zong SIM.
terms.trialText: New users receive a one (1) day free trial with full premium access. At the end of the trial, the selected subscription automatically becomes active unless cancelled before the trial ends. The free trial is available once per eligible Zong subscriber.
terms.billingText: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. By subscribing, you authorize Zong to deduct applicable charges from your prepaid balance or postpaid bill. If insufficient balance exists, renewal may fail or be retried per Zong policies.
terms.cancellationText: You may unsubscribe at any time through SMS or the Zaheen website. Cancelling before the free trial ends prevents any subscription charge. Charges already deducted after the trial are non-refundable except where required by law.
terms.accountSecurity: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account and all activities performed using it.
terms.acceptableUseText: Do not share subscriptions, copy content, attempt unauthorized access, upload malicious software, or use the Platform unlawfully.
terms.ipText: All content, logos, study material, graphics, videos and software are the property of Zaheen and may not be copied or redistributed without written permission.
terms.contentText: Content is provided for educational purposes only. Zaheen does not currently provide certificates and does not guarantee examination results or academic success.
terms.privacyNoticeText: Use of the Platform is also governed by the Zaheen Privacy Policy.
terms.availabilityText: Services may be interrupted due to maintenance, technical issues, network outages or circumstances beyond our control.
terms.liabilityText: Zaheen shall not be liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the Platform to the fullest extent permitted by law.
terms.terminationText: Zaheen may suspend or terminate access for violation of these Terms or fraudulent activity.
terms.lawText: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
terms.acceptanceText: By accessing, subscribing to, or using Zaheen, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agree to these Terms & Conditions.

description.title: Description
description.text:
This comprehensive course takes you from complete beginner to professional level with a structured, practical curriculum.

You will explore real-world scenarios guided by step-by-step video lectures that break down complex topics into digestible lessons. Each chapter builds upon the last, ensuring steady and confident progress.

Whether you're looking to upskill for career advancement or simply explore a new domain, this course provides everything you need to succeed and stand out in your field.
